evidence_status: exploratory pilot; frozen before retrieval results are inspected
purpose: Screen action-selection headroom and whether passive numeric probe profiles predict real-query action utility; no learned probe selector in this pilot.

corpus.chunking: none; model input truncation is reported separately
corpus.sampling_capability: one exploration-seed document inspected when its probe is selected

retrieval.configuration_unit: corpus configurations are correlated, not independent families

document_split.normalization: NFKC, casefold, whitespace collapse; body text alone when nonempty, otherwise title
document_split.assignment_hash: SHA256(str(seed) + ':' + group_hash); first 64 bits divided by 2**64 < exploration_fraction
document_split.eligibility: At least one positive judgment; every judged document exists in the full corpus; all positive support documents belong to the held-out pool.

query_selection.rule: run_pilot.select_ids sorts eligible query IDs by SHA256(json.dumps([salt, str(query_id)], sort_keys=True).encode()), with Python json.dumps default separators; salt is 'test-20260909' for target test and 'train-20260909' for source train. Take at most the requested count.
query_selection.source_partition: Router-training count is min(192, max(1, floor(0.75 * selected_source_query_count))); remaining selected source IDs calibrate the passive profile correction. With the full 256-query sample this is 192 training and 64 calibration queries.

source_target_roles.hyperparameters: Fixed defaults below; no target-label selection or optimization.
source_target_roles.future_confirmatory_eligibility: Both families are pilot-only after these results inform any method decision.

actions.generator: fixed deterministic lexical transformations; no LLM calls
actions.implementation: Frozen action definitions are in the pilot retrieval implementation and copied into the result manifest.

family_interpretation.exact_title: lexical overlap/easy control; title-derived query with no fallback. An empty title produces an invalid probe, charges one inspection, and performs no searches or profile update.
family_interpretation.body_terms: lexical document-derived proxy, not a validated indirect semantic query

probes.sampling: Sort exploration document IDs lexicographically, shuffle with Python random.Random(seed).shuffle, and take the first 64. Same document sample/order for all methods, backends, and probe families within a corpus and seed; inspect content only when a probe is selected.
probes.contrastive_pair: Cycle original versus keywords, identifier_terms, lead_clause.
probes.invalid_probe_cost: One sampled-document inspection; no search. Counts, reasons, and actual operations are reported.
probes.synthetic_score: Known-document reciprocal rank; other retrieved documents are not labeled irrelevant.

source_router.inputs: deployment-computable query features plus documented backend flag
source_router.target: source router-training query nDCG@10 for each action

models.source_fixed_action: Within each backend, choose highest mean nDCG@10 on the source router-training queries only.

profile.statistics: original-versus-action mean reciprocal-rank differences, globally and within query-feature bucket
profile.query_bucket: 2 * int(token_count > 8) + int(any identifier-like token), using the engine's case-preserving surface tokenizer and fixed identifier predicate; four buckets numbered 0 through 3.

passive_profile_correction.training_queries: source-only calibration query IDs, disjoint from source router-training query IDs
passive_profile_correction.training_histories: source onboarding seeds and budgets, with the source router frozen
passive_profile_correction.target: real action-original nDCG difference minus frozen source-router prediction difference
passive_profile_correction.application: Add the frozen source-trained correction to the source router score at target time.

models.probe_only: Choose the action with maximum shrunk global probe reciprocal-rank difference; original action has zero delta.

comparators.rrf_extra_search: Fuse original query results and the best non-original alternative chosen on source router-training queries; charge two searches per task.

outcomes.primary_diagnostic: nDCG@10 on eligible held-out real queries, reported per family and backend plus equal-family macro
secondary: onboarding and serving operation counts and measured latency
outcomes.headroom_screen_interpretation: Provisional descriptive oracle advantage, not a significance threshold; compare against source router and target-best fixed action.
outcomes.uncertainty: Paired queries and seeds; profile/history is an adaptation unit. No broad family-population claims from two pilot families.
outcomes.gate_A: Meaningful action-selection headroom in more than one natural environment.
outcomes.gate_B: Disjoint real-query benefit beyond source priors and lexical controls; correlation alone does not establish transfer.
outcomes.gate_C: Not tested: requires a learned selector and matched random, fixed, and uncertainty baselines after headroom/signal justify expansion.
outcomes.gate_D: Descriptive cost curves only until quality at matched total cost and stronger inference-time alternatives are established.

cost.break_even: Only compute onboarding_cost / per_task_cost_saving when quality is comparable and per-task cost saving is positive; otherwise show quality-cost curves.
